narrationTexts: Now let's look at each file still using `db.query`.
Good, `cache.query` is unrelated (different object). Now applying the migration to all 12 files.
All 12 files migrated. Let's verify no remaining `db.query` calls outside the vendor file.
finalText:
Migration finished. All 12 application files (analytics, orders×2, billing×2, support×2, catalog×2, accounts×3) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })` instead of `db.query(sql, params)`.

One file was intentionally left as-is: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` is explicitly marked "vendored copy... do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes are silently lost." Migrating `db.query` there wouldn't stick and would violate that comment, so it still calls the deprecated form. If `db.query` needs to be fully removed from `lib/db.js`, this vendor adapter will need to be handled separately (e.g., pinned/patched upstream, or a wrapper shim), since it's the one remaining caller.
